metadata.source: GitHub connector source files, GitHub review threads, Actions logs; standards from publisher sites
metadata.local_full_repo_execution: NOT_PERFORMED - container network unable to resolve github.com
metadata.limitations: Source-confirmed is not independently re-executed; absent evidence is not proof of failure; count is bounded to reviewed surface.

findings.title: Nested process-substitution loses context
findings.mechanism: Вкладене аналізування маркера PROCSUB може звернутися до відсутнього елемента procsubs і спричинити IndexError, після якого persistence collector відкачується.
findings.falsifier: Fixtures для eval sh <(...) і eval source <(...) не піднімають exception; повертають коректну класифікацію або explicit limitation; жодні інші знахідки не втрачені.

findings.title: Command substitution taint is aggregated across unrelated words
findings.mechanism: Код збирає sub_emits з усіх word, а потім трактує результат як джерело виконуваного операнда; нешкідливий аргумент може породити REMOTE_SCRIPT_PIPELINE.
findings.falsifier: Pair fixtures: downloaded data only as argv -> no executable-code finding; downloaded code in -c/eval -> finding; labels scoped to exact operand.

findings.title: Here-string misclassified as network redirection
findings.mechanism: Для кожного redirect не перевіряється оператор; <<< /dev/tcp/.. є даними, не відкриттям сокета.
findings.falsifier: cat <<< /dev/tcp/example/80 -> no NETWORK_REDIRECTION; exec 3<>/dev/tcp/example/80 -> positive.

findings.title: HOME-relative source path with double slash escapes base
findings.mechanism: self.home / target[len(prefix):] скидає базу, якщо суфікс починається /.
findings.falsifier: Fixtures $HOME//.bash_aliases, ~//.bash_aliases, звичайний шлях, symlink, offline root; тільки шлях усередині target home використовується.

findings.title: Eval-site qualification uses aggregate counts
findings.mechanism: _shell_limit порівнює загальні unresolved_expansions і len(evaluated_programs), тому невідоме джерело може бути зараховано довіреним іншою підстановкою.
findings.falsifier: Mixed eval із packaged $(dircolors) + $hook та multiple eval-sites -> PARSE_UNSUPPORTED, ніколи COMPLETED лише через арифметику лічильників.

findings.title: Relative executable name aliases packaged executable
findings.mechanism: PurePosixPath(name).name перетворює ./dircolors на dircolors і підставляє системний executable замість фактичного.
findings.falsifier: ./prog, ../prog, path/to/prog ніколи не отримують package attestation за basename; тільки точно встановлена канонічна ціль.

findings.title: Relay-program denylist is not sound
findings.mechanism: dd відсутній у RELAY_PROGRAMS; пакетний digest самої програми не засвідчує дані, що вона видає.
findings.falsifier: eval of output copied from arbitrary file via dd/other relay -> PARSE_UNSUPPORTED; proof cases with trusted program whose output is not input.

findings.title: Nested command substitutions inside ${...} discarded
findings.mechanism: _dollar склеює складний parameter expansion у marker VAR:? без subcommands; виконувана підстановка може зникнути і з findings, і з limitations.
findings.falsifier: Nested ${var:-$(...)} variants recognized or explicit UNPARSED/UNSUPPORTED limitation; no clean acceptance of unexamined executable syntax.

findings.title: Unbounded recursive quote/parameter parser
findings.mechanism: _double_quote_end і _balanced рекурсивно викликаються до загального MAX_DEPTH аналізатора; глибокі inputs піднімають RecursionError.
findings.falsifier: Nested quoted expansions at 500+ levels give bounded NESTING_LIMIT/UNPARSED_QUOTING, no exception, bounded CPU/RSS and per-file incompleteness.

findings.title: hidepid mount visibility incorrectly treated as kernel hiding
findings.mechanism: EPERM у kill(pid,0) означає існування, але hidepid=2 легітимно приховує /proc іншого користувача.
findings.falsifier: hidepid=0/1/2 and same/foreign UID fixtures; restricted view -> scope limitation, not HIDDEN_PROCESS.

findings.title: Transient sockets create NETLINK_ONLY false alarm
findings.mechanism: netlink_only = netlink - before - after спрацьовує саме для короткоживучого сокета між snapshot-ами.
findings.falsifier: Transient UDP churn -> no high-severity hidden-listener finding; stable discrepancy survives independently repeated confirmation.

findings.title: Partial ss output used for negative inference
findings.mechanism: Статус PARTIAL приймається як повна таблиця, попри truncation; стабільні procfs listeners оголошуються прихованими.
findings.falsifier: Command PARTIAL with truncated empty ss result -> PARTIAL coverage, no absence-based hidden listener; exact command gap recorded.

findings.title: Listener identity collapses address and network family
findings.mechanism: Набір (proto,port) не відрізняє 127.0.0.1:8080 від 127.0.0.2:8080 або IPv4 від IPv6.
findings.falsifier: Distinct interface/address/family fixtures remain distinct; exact local endpoint identity used in both views with privacy-safe hashing if stored.

findings.title: Offline RPM scope limit suppresses unrelated package failure
findings.mechanism: Essential checks видаляються за будь-якою ознакою LIVE_ONLY_NOT_IN_OFFLINE_IMAGE, навіть якщо той самий collector має реальні disk-reading gaps.
findings.falsifier: Offline RPM image with unreadable/symlinked repo config -> INCONCLUSIVE; виключаються тільки повністю SKIPPED live-only collector-и.

findings.title: Unreadable/over-budget dpkg metadata silently dropped
findings.mechanism: _dpkg_md5 пропускає unreadable >4MiB *.md5sums і caps, після чого верифікація порожнього індексу може завершитися COMPLETED.
findings.falsifier: Files >4MiB, total >128MiB, >20k records, malformed/permission -> explicit incomplete; records omitted measured separately.

findings.title: Offline journal parent symlink crosses root boundary
findings.mechanism: _journal перевіряє лише final directory; journalctl --directory може перейти через ancestor symlink у live host.
findings.falsifier: Ancestor symlink under root must be refused; no host-journal leaks; TOCTOU-safe directory handling or skip with limitation.

findings.title: AST unparse causes false mutant kills
findings.mechanism: Переформатування незмінених фрагментів змінює лапки, що ламає source-regex тести, і може створити KILLED без перевірки мутації.
findings.falsifier: No-op AST roundtrip must not fail suite; mutate only original source span or semantic tests must ignore formatting; mutation tester self-tests.

findings.title: Continuation-line operator modifications omitted from diff mutations
findings.mechanism: Відбір лише за node.lineno пропускає оператор на іншому рядку багаторядкового вузла.
findings.falsifier: Mutation of and→or on changed continuation line always yields eligible mutant; 0 selected on modified semantic code -> FAIL.

findings.title: Mutation budget expiry returns success with NOT_RUN
findings.mechanism: Exit logic рахує SURVIVED, NO_TESTS, ERROR, але не NOT_RUN.
findings.falsifier: tools/mutate.py --module detectors --budget 0 exits nonzero when any NOT_RUN; test verify --allow-survivors never masquerades as full coverage.

findings.title: Package metadata version inconsistent with runtime
findings.mechanism: pyproject [project].version=0.1.3 while falsicore.__version__=0.2.0.
findings.falsifier: Runtime version == wheel/SDist metadata == release tag == asset label; single version SSOT tested.

findings.title: Evidence freshness accepts stale counts and coverage
findings.mechanism: --check порівнює schema/version/suite exit лише; does not bind test inputs or measured coverage.
findings.falsifier: Tamper suite.ran, test_files, coverage, SHA and suite exit -> --check FAIL unless all exact measurements and source digest validated.

findings.title: Evidence regeneration poisoned by self-referential test
findings.mechanism: unittest suite перевіряє existing RELEASE_EVIDENCE --check while generator itself runs suite to write a fresh file.
findings.falsifier: Start from stale/red evidence, run controlled regenerate -> green once true implementation gates pass, without manual JSON editing.

findings.title: Line-wide #no mutate hides behavior-changing mutants
findings.mechanism: Any mutation on annotated line becomes ANNOTATED; os.read(fd,0) suppresses observable output, so it is not equivalent.
findings.falsifier: Only exact proven-equivalent mutation IDs may be waived; 65536→0 mutation must be executed and killed by child stdout capture test.

findings.title: Evidence generator success ignores failing ancillary measurements
findings.mechanism: measure() stores exits from Ruff/Bandit/mypy/validity, but main() returns exit based solely on suite.exit.
findings.falsifier: Inject static_analysis.detection_validity.exit=1 with suite.exit=0 -> generator and --check nonzero; all required fields and inputs verified.

findings.title: Tag release job permits skipping property tests
findings.mechanism: release.yml does not install Hypothesis and does not set FALSICORE_REQUIRE_HYPOTHESIS=1; property-test classes skip when missing.
findings.falsifier: Tag pipeline installs pinned PBT dependency and fails if PBT absent, skipped or red; same HEAD passes required static, validity, mutation and CodeQL gates.

findings.title: Published tag trails main by six commits under same runtime version
findings.mechanism: v0.2.0 tag = 70ed7107, main = 41745142, ahead_by = 6; functionality and tests changed without release version update.
findings.falsifier: Release identity defined by immutable commit; new version and tag for changed artifacts; no false parity assertion between main and published asset.

findings.title: GitHub cannot verify SSH tag signature
findings.mechanism: Annotated tag exists but GitHub API returns verified=false reason=unknown_key; it does not prove a forged tag.
findings.falsifier: Verify signing public key through independent trusted identity channel; repository GitHub Verified or equivalent trust-root proof; sign release manifest/attestation.

findings.title: Default branch lacks branch protection/rulesets
findings.mechanism: GitHub branches/main protected=false and repository rulesets endpoint returns []; direct changes are not blocked by these controls.
findings.falsifier: Main protection/rulesets enforced; direct push rejected, required exact-head CI before merge; solo maintainer does not need separate human approval.

findings.title: Whole-package scheduled job accepts survivors by design
findings.mechanism: --allow-survivors makes successful job outcome a measurement receipt, not mutation-quality closure; table is partial and historical.
findings.falsifier: Publish complete per-module mutation receipts bound to HEAD and treat unmeasured critical-path mutants as NOT_ESTABLISHED; strict release gate blocks unresolved non-equivalent critical mutants.

findings.title: Pacman mtree index silently discards incomplete database
findings.mechanism: _pacman_records drops bad/oversized mtree and record/byte cap without passing incompleteness to verification.
findings.falsifier: Malformed, unreadable, >cap pacman mtree fixtures -> PARTIAL, exact missing-record counters; no COMPLETED with incomplete reference set.

findings.title: No representative real-malware corpus validation
findings.mechanism: docs/RELEASE_EVIDENCE explicitly lists malware-corpus validation under not_performed.
findings.falsifier: Pre-registered corpus with confirmed labels, provenance, holdout split, environment coverage and per-rule TPR/FNR with confidence intervals.

findings.title: Field false-alarm rate, precision and time to detection unknown
findings.mechanism: 57 positive and 27 benign-twin synthetic scenarios cannot establish field prevalence-conditioned precision or operational error costs.
findings.falsifier: Independent benign/malicious host-day corpus: measure FPR per host-day, TPR, PPV by base-rate scenario, detection delay, CIs and subgroup shift.

findings.title: No measured privileged system-scope host scan
findings.mechanism: Explicitly listed in not_performed, and simulator coverage cannot replace real kernel permission behavior.
findings.falsifier: Isolated disposable Linux VM privileged scan + command audit proving read-only behavior, bounded subprocess lifecycle, accurate coverage.

findings.title: No real mounted offline image evidence
findings.mechanism: Offline tested only on constructed fixture images; real-image acquisition/provenance verification not measured.
findings.falsifier: Read-only mounted forensic image with known ground truth and independent image hash, absolute-path containment proof, verified provenance log.

findings.title: Cross-platform reproducible build not established
findings.mechanism: Two identical ZIP/pyz builds on the same platform do not prove equivalence across interpreters and runners.
findings.falsifier: Independent runners for target matrix produce defined identical bytes or documented platform-specific reproducibility contracts and manifest parity.

findings.title: Independent external implementation review not demonstrated
findings.mechanism: Project acknowledges non-independent same-family review; cannot assert external certification.
findings.falsifier: Independent challenge audit against frozen commit, seeded defects and evidence receipts; no mandatory separate human sign-off in solo gate.

findings.title: Release assets lack demonstrated signed build attestation and SBOM
findings.mechanism: Published release shows 4 assets: full.zip/sha256 and pyz/sha256; plain hashes alone are not independent author/build provenance.
findings.falsifier: Artifact SHA256 bound to signed provenance with source commit, builder identity and dependencies; verifiable by external consumer; SBOM published where applicable.

findings.title: Release evidence has no exact source/test fingerprint
findings.mechanism: RELEASE_EVIDENCE.json includes version and date, no HEAD commit SHA or source/test Merkle digest; --check cannot detect same-version drift.
findings.falsifier: Attestation exact HEAD, source tree, test inventory, toolchain and command inputs; any single changed input forces invalidation/re-measurement.

findings.title: Private vulnerability disclosure configuration not confirmed
findings.mechanism: SECURITY.md requests enabling private vulnerability reporting; actual repo configuration could not be verified with available endpoint.
findings.falsifier: Confirm active private vulnerability reporting via permitted read-only GitHub configuration/maintainer evidence; publish non-sensitive response policy.

historical_fixed.title: Offline image home resolved from live NSS
historical_fixed.current_source_evidence: Audit._image_passwd uses root and image passwd

historical_fixed.title: Package parsers not wired into collector
historical_fixed.current_source_evidence: Current Audit.packages routes dpkg, rpm, pacman, apk

historical_fixed.title: /proc/self symlink inhibits live collector
historical_fixed.current_source_evidence: Current Audit._proc_self uses own numeric PID
